class.name: NNNodeQuerySystem
class.brief_description: Singleton that time-budgets and schedules Node Query System (NQS) queries across frames.
class.description: Engine singleton that runs spatial queries posted via [method post_query] within a configurable per-frame microsecond budget ([member run_queries_time_budget_per_frame_usec]), spreading expensive queries across frames without frame spikes. Call [method run_queries] once per frame from your game loop (for example, in [method Node._physics_process]) to advance queued queries. Access directly through [code]NNNodeQuerySystem[/code] without instantiating it.

method.name: clear_queries
method.description: Cancels all queued high-priority and regular-priority queries (for example, on scene reset). Search spaces automatically unregister themselves when exiting the tree or freed.

method.name: get_num_active_high_priority_queries
method.description: Returns the number of active high-priority queries in the queue.

method.name: get_num_active_regular_priority_queries
method.description: Returns the number of active regular-priority queries in the queue.

method.name: get_post_queries_time_elapsed_usec
method.description: Returns microseconds spent in [method post_query] during the previous frame.

method.name: get_run_queries_time_elapsed_usec
method.description: Returns microseconds taken by the last [method run_queries] call.

method.name: initialize_performance_counters
method.description: Registers custom [Performance] monitors for NQS timings in the editor's Debugger > Monitors tab. Call once at startup.

method.name: post_query
method.description: Queues [param search_space] to run under [method run_queries] in either the high-priority or regular-priority queue. Returns [code]1[/code] if posted, or [code]-1[/code] if invalid or already queued.

method.name: run_queries
method.description: Advances queued queries up to [member run_queries_time_budget_per_frame_usec]. Call once per frame from your game loop.

method.name: stop_query
method.description: Cancels and removes a queued [param search_space] query. Returns [code]true[/code] if it was active and removed.

members.member: Time slice in microseconds given to each high-priority query per round-robin pass (minimum [code]1[/code]).
Time slice in microseconds given to each regular-priority query per round-robin pass (minimum [code]1[/code]).
Total microsecond budget per [method run_queries] call. Unfinished queries resume on the next call.
Fraction ([code]0..1[/code]) of the frame budget reserved for high-priority queries before regular-priority queries run.
